name: CMS HRRP Readmission Penalty Scorecard
description: Identifies 30-day inpatient readmissions across all six CMS HRRP condition categories (AMI, Heart Failure, Pneumonia, COPD, CABG, THA/TKA) and simulates the resulting penalty exposure under the Hospital Readmissions Reduction Program. Operates on SNOMED condition + procedure codes — no DRG codes required.
author: Foxtrot Communications

parameters.label: Lookback period (months)
parameters.description: How far back to scan for index admissions. 36 months captures more procedure-based conditions (CABG, THA/TKA) which are less frequent.

parameters.label: Hospital performance scenario
parameters.description: baseline = real OMOP data only. high_risk = deterministic synthetic readmission overlay to demonstrate above-benchmark penalty exposure.

parameters.label: AMI target readmission rate
parameters.description: High-risk scenario: target % of AMI index admissions that readmit. CMS national avg 16.5%.

parameters.label: HF target readmission rate
parameters.description: High-risk scenario: target % of Heart Failure index admissions that readmit. CMS national avg 21.5%.

parameters.label: Pneumonia target readmission rate
parameters.description: High-risk scenario: target % of Pneumonia index admissions that readmit. CMS national avg 15.0%.

parameters.label: COPD target readmission rate
parameters.description: High-risk scenario: target % of COPD index admissions that readmit. CMS national avg 19.8%.

parameters.label: CABG target readmission rate
parameters.description: High-risk scenario: target % of CABG index admissions that readmit. CMS national avg 12.55%.

parameters.label: THA/TKA target readmission rate
parameters.description: High-risk scenario: target % of THA/TKA index admissions that readmit. CMS national avg 4.5%.

scorecard.description: Condition-level HRRP scorecard — all 6 CMS conditions with ERR, penalty exposure, and benchmark comparison.

trend.description: Monthly 30-day readmission trend per condition with CMS benchmark and rolling 3-month average.

patient_detail.description: Patient-level readmission events with index cost, readmit cost, and days to readmit.
